increments.name: Login, MFA and session handling
components: Generic authentication error and expired-challenge state
Session bootstrap, refresh and logout client
boundaries: Follow AuthResult challenge/session-handoff states and exact OpenAPI request schemas
Use client_kind WEB, an in-memory client binding, and the x-auth-challenge-binding header where specified
Only redeem a purpose-matched one-time handoff after required proof; WEB SESSION redemption sets server cookies and returns no body
Privileged tenant roles must complete or enroll required TOTP before protected access
Do not include account recovery, MFA recovery, invitations, or general credential issuance in this slice

increments.name: Authenticated shell, tenant selection and role-aware navigation
boundaries: Use only memberships returned for the authenticated user through MyMembershipPage
Map only the five approved Q-01 tenant template role codes to navigation affordances; unknown/custom role codes receive no operational navigation; client role codes never authorize
Send X-Organization-Id as an untrusted selected-tenant selector on tenant operations
Clear tenant-bound client data when the selected organization changes
Do not call permission catalogs to infer grants or treat client navigation as authorization

increments.name: Read-only incident list and detail
components: Loading, empty, generic error, forbidden, not-found and expired-session views
boundaries: Use the exact existing list/get operations, cursor/limit contract and Incident schema
Send selected organization only through the documented header
Do not add create, update, transition, assignment, location, movement, dispatch or reporting controls
Field Responder access remains assignment-scoped and backend fail-closed until valid assignment evidence exists

tenant_reads.scope: TENANT subject to the exact existing grants and redaction policy

field_responder.scope: ASSIGNED only; fail closed without assignment evidence

role_and_permission_dependencies.platform_super_admin: No tenant operational grant or automatic tenant-content access
role_and_permission_dependencies.organization_admin: Read-only G-04 only; no incident writes or transition authority
role_and_permission_dependencies.client_authority: No client-side role or navigation state grants access; API authorization is authoritative

accessibility: Programmatic labels and field error association
Screen-reader status announcements for asynchronous state changes
Automated axe scan plus manual keyboard review
responsive: Navigation and tables remain usable at narrow widths
Touch targets and focus states remain visible

scenarios: privileged MFA challenge, successful TOTP, invalid/expired challenge denial
TOTP enrollment challenge and purpose-bound setup handoff
session refresh, expiry, logout and cookie/CSRF behavior
membership selection and tenant switch data invalidation
unauthorized routes and cross-tenant incident denial
incident list/detail read-only projections and state handling
desktop/mobile layout, console/page errors, failed-request detection and recovery
artifact_controls: Screenshots and traces contain synthetic data only
Never capture passwords, TOTP/recovery values, tokens, cookie headers or handoff material
Disable Playwright tracing for flows that submit credentials unless request bodies and headers are provably redacted
Collect network diagnostics as method/status and sanitized path only

exact_exclusions: Any new backend endpoint, permission, role, table, or migration; the specifically authorized bounded existing response-contract reconciliation is documented separately
Incident create/update/transition, cancellation or closure UI
Assignment, vehicle, movement, dispatch, GPS, media, offline sync or reporting UI
Account recovery, MFA recovery, invitations, organization administration or user provisioning
Production authentication, production data, external notifications, deployment or emergency operations
dependencies_and_open_gates: Project Owner approval of UF-01A/B/C is recorded; implementation remains within this exact frozen scope
Verify browser behavior of the existing WEB session handoff, trusted origin, Secure cookies and CSRF headers against real Nest HTTP tests
Provide synthetic HTTP fixtures for tenant-only Commander/Operator, Auditor, Field Responder, Organization Admin and platform-only administrator
M01-R01, Q-05, Q-06 and Q-08 remain open; this proposal closes none of them
No production KMS, logging, deployment or recovery readiness is implied
